Top round roast is perfect for a beef stew. Here's a recipe that my Dad gave me that I use all of the time:

Chop raw carrots, onions, celery, mushrooms, potatoes and put into the crock pot. Add a can or so of diced tomatoes with liquid. Add a can of French Onion soup.

Chop the meat into stew-sized bites, removing the fatty parts. Toss with some flour (can use GF flour if you need to), salt, and pepper. Brown in a skillet. Put it over the veggies in the crock pot. Sprinkle a packet of French Onion "soup mix" on top of the meat. It won't look "liquidy" like a soup at the beginning, but once everything cooks and renders down, the liquid level rises and covers it all with delicious soup.

Cook on low for about 6 hours (Low if your slow cooker is overpowered like mine. I've been using a friend's slow cooker, and that won't simmer at low. So use your judgement). Stir it every couple of hours. Enjoy!
